public FunctionDefinition <mask>(UnresolvedIdentifier identifier) {
    return sessionContext
            .getSessionState()
            .functionCatalog
            .lookupFunction(identifier)
            .orElseThrow(
                    () ->
                            new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    String.format(
                                            "Can not find the definition: %s.",
                                            identifier.asSummaryString())))
            .getDefinition();
}
